# UniOpt

> UniOpt is a declarative Bash 3.2+ command-line option library. A single schema drives parsing, validation, help, Markdown, Bash completion, JSON introspection, and an optional GUI command-line advisor while preserving exact argv boundaries.

Use `lib/uniopt.sh` from Bash. Schema registration and introspection are side-effect-free. The parser does not use `eval`, generated parser files, or whitespace serialization. Semantic option IDs are stable and separate from CLI spellings.

Normalized schemas support a semantic Bash -> JSON -> generated Bash -> JSON round trip. Language bindings retain Bash destinations and callback names while callback implementations remain application code.

## Public API

- [`uniopt_reset`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_reset): clear the active schema and result state; no arguments.
- [`uniopt_schema COMMAND [ATTRIBUTES]`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_schema-command-attributes): set command metadata; accepts `--summary`, `--ui-confirm`, `--unknown`, and `--unknown-dest`. It reserves `-h`, `--help`, and `--gui`.
- [`uniopt_option ID ATTRIBUTES`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_option-id-attributes): declare an option, type, spelling, destination, default, validation, repetition, and optional UI metadata.
- [`uniopt_alias ID ATTRIBUTES`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_alias-id-attributes): declare a no-value spelling that stores constants in other semantic options.
- [`uniopt_positional ID ATTRIBUTES`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_positional-id-attributes): declare required, optional, or remainder positional values.
- [`uniopt_constraint KIND ID...`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_constraint-kind-id): declare `mutex`, `one-of`, `requires`, or `conflicts` relationships.
- [`uniopt_parse ARG...`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_parse-arg): apply defaults, parse the exact argv, validate, and set `UNIOPT_ACTION` for built-in help or GUI requests.
- [`uniopt_validate`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_validate): validate registered constraints against parsed explicit occurrences.
- [`uniopt_get ID [OUTPUT_VARIABLE]`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_get-id-output_variable): read one scalar value safely.
- [`uniopt_get_source ID`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_get_source-id): read value provenance.
- [`uniopt_get_all ID`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_get_all-id): copy a repeatable or remainder result into `UNIOPT_RESULT`.
- [`uniopt_get_unknown`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_get_unknown): copy collected unknown arguments into `UNIOPT_RESULT`.
- [`uniopt_help`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_help), [`uniopt_markdown`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_markdown), [`uniopt_json`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_json), and [`uniopt_completion`](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/#uniopt_completion-command-function): render deterministic interfaces from the active schema.

Compatibility names `uniopt_value`, `uniopt_provenance`, and `uniopt_values` delegate to the getter API. Complete attributes, types, validation behavior, JSON fields, GUI metadata, and migration notes are in the public API reference.

## Declaration option summary

- Schema: `--summary TEXT`, `--ui-confirm TEXT`, `--unknown error|collect|stop`, and `--unknown-dest VARIABLE`.
- Option identity and storage: `--short -x`, `--long --name`, `--neg-long --no-name`, `--dest VARIABLE`, `--type TYPE`, `--metavar WORD`, and `--help TEXT`.
- Option defaults and behavior: `--default VALUE`, `--default-fn FUNCTION`, `--default-env VARIABLE`, `--repeatable`, `--required`, `--internal`, `--choice VALUE`, `--validator FUNCTION`, and `--store-const VALUE`.
- Alias: `--short`, `--long`, `--help`, repeated `--set OPTION_ID VALUE`, and the common UI attributes.
- Positional: `--dest`, `--type`, `--metavar`, `--help`, `--required`, `--remainder`, `--validator`, and the common UI attributes.
- UI presentation: `--ui-label`, `--ui-group`, `--ui-control`, `--ui-placeholder`, `--ui-advanced`, `--ui-order`, `--ui-min`, `--ui-max`, `--ui-step`, and path-only `--ui-file-mode auto|open|save|directory`.
- Types: `string`, `path`, `int`, `integer`, `uint`, `enum`, `boolean`, and `tristate`.
- Completion: `uniopt_completion [COMMAND [FUNCTION]]`; omitted values derive from the schema command.

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/user-guide/): adoption tutorial and examples.
- [Public API reference](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/api-reference/): complete function signatures and every declaration attribute.
- [Bash and JSON schema round trip](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/schema-round-trip/): normalized JSON, language bindings, callbacks, safe Bash generation, and the formal schema.
- [Installation and GUI](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/installation-and-gui/): packaging, frontend selection, and path controls.
- [GUI advisor design](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/gui-design/): argv model, validation, execution, and security boundaries.
- [Bash 3.2 compatibility](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/bash-3.2-compatibility/): supported language baseline and result API.
- [Full documentation as text](https://bigdft-group.github.io/uniopt/llms-full.txt): manuals combined into one agent-friendly file.
